_README.reason: CREDITS-BUNDLE-HEURISTIC-1 allowlist. check-credits-coverage.mjs's BUNDLE_FILE_RE flags any *.bundle.mjs/*.bundle.js filename as vendored third-party by convention. ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md §4.1 mandates that exact suffix, 'exactly the shipped _detmath shape', for ANY shared, inline-consumed kernel composition module, regardless of whether its contents are original or vendored — so the filename alone cannot distinguish the two. This registry is the discriminator: a *.bundle.mjs file is either covered by data/credits-registry.json (genuinely vendored) or listed here with a written reason (genuinely original, authored in-house). A file matching neither is failed by the gate. Every entry carries a mandatory `reason`; an entry without one fails the gate on that ground alone. Keys are repo-relative paths with forward slashes. `_README` is inert — it names no bundle path, so it shields nothing. PER-KERNEL-CONFIG-SHARD-1: entries for bundles under chaingraph/kernels/ live in a per-bundle sibling chaingraph/kernels/<bundle-stem>.authorship.json (for _amort.bundle.mjs: _amort.bundle.authorship.json) holding the same { "reason": ... } object; scripts/lib-per-kernel-config.mjs merges them over this file, and an entry present in both places is refused. Add new kernel-bundle entries as siblings, not here.
